A thoughtful approach to building

I’m a software developer with experience building full-stack products across banking, healthcare, and supply-chain platforms. I work across React, Angular, Java, and cloud services, bringing ideas from an early sketch through to dependable, production-ready software.

I care about the details that make technology work well for people: reliable systems behind the scenes and clear, accessible experiences on the screen. I’m also curious about how data and AI can make useful products even better.

Reliable systems. Clear, human experiences.
